description: Tests the ability of users to configure test settings including test name, cloud/git type, and OpenAI API token, and save the configuration.
steps: Navigate to the 'RoostGPT Config' page from the navigation menu.
Type 'Sample Test' into the test name input field.
Select 'Cloud Git' as the git type by ensuring the 'Cloud Git' radio button is selected.
Type a valid OpenAI API token into the OpenAI token input field.
Click the OpenAI token unmask icon to verify the token entry.
Click the 'Save Configuration' button to save the test settings.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed indicating successful save.
expected_results: Test settings are successfully saved, and a confirmation message is displayed.
The OpenAI token input value is correctly visible after unmasking.
edge_cases: Entering a test name with special characters.
Leaving the OpenAI token field blank and attempting to save.
Entering an invalid OpenAI token format.
Changing the git type to 'Server Git' and verifying the selection.
Attempting to save configuration without selecting a git type.
data_requirements: Default git type set to 'Cloud Git'
dependencies: User is logged into the application.
Default configurations for git type and test settings are loaded.
api_interactions: Verify if the OpenAI token is validated via an API call during save.
Monitor if the save configuration triggers an API request to persist data.
performance_metrics: Measure time taken to save the configuration.
Verify the responsiveness of the input fields during typing.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure all input fields and buttons are navigable using the keyboard.
Verify proper ARIA labels for all input and button elements.
Check for sufficient color contrast on the confirmation message.
